modelDescription: When compromise is not an option. With the metal parts made of Sako's high-grade stainless steel, this is a sturdy and long-lasting choice for all weather conditions. Additional features include a weather resistant synthetic buttstock, enhanced recoil pad, single stage adjustable trigger and an extra strong recoil lug. 1 MOA accuracy is guaranteed by Tikka.
